descriptions.d25i_ingame_menu_fill_8011385c: In-game menu fill: resolves the list object from the table at +108, empties its commands, creates the label table (class 0x80419e68), reads GameOver.GameType into a String, sizes the names, commands and ids arrays to 3 for Multiplayer and Network and 2 otherwise, then fills Lang.Continue, Lang.Quit and, for three entries, Lang.DrawRound with their FE.KillPopUp commands and the id +40, and attaches the table.
